# Complete a z-stream cluster update with {{ cgu_operator }} {#core-cluster-upgrades-z-stream}

You can update clusters to z-stream patch releases by using {{ rh_rhacm }} policies and {{ cgu_operator_full }} ({{ cgu_operator }}).
